inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours: Training certificates were not available for review .
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours (26 TAC §746.901(6))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: The sign in and out log was not maintained. Corrected at Inspection: The times and initials were placed for those who had not been sign in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The childcare operation did not have a current fire inspection. The last fire inspection conducted was on 6/06/24.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Two large pillows designated for circle time exhibited significant areas of liquid and white stains in a classroom, toddler 2. Additionally, there was one smaller pillow that appeared to be dirty and in a state of deterioration. Note: The pillows were removed during the inspection.      Two vents at floor level were noted to be accumulating dust and debris, with one vent appearing loose. Both vents were subsequently cleaned and secured.     Additionally, two death cockroaches were observed on the after-school classroom floor and were removed during the inspection.      The outdoor area utilized by the children was observed with candy wrappers and a cap from a beer and water bottle. These items were subsequently collected and removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs: The 29 children present at the childcare operation were not signed in.   Corrected at Inspection: The children were signed in during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs (26 TAC §746.603(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs: The sign in and out log was not maintained. The children present were not signed in.     Corrected at Inspection: The times and initials were placed for those who had not been sign in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs (26 TAC §746.603(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: A caregiver hired on 5/08/23 did not have the following required annual training topics:     (1)Emergency preparedness;    (2)Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations,   (3)Administering medication   (4)Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction    (5)Understanding building and physical premises safety, including identification and protection from hazards that can cause bodily injury such as electrical hazards, bodies of water, and vehicular traffic ; and    (6)Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report: The health inspection report was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(12))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans: A written activity plan was not available for review for Infants, Toddlers, and School age children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans (26 TAC §746.2203(a))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: 5 out of 6 files reviewed for caregivers and director did not have CPR training that included hands-on skill-based instruction.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: Two caregivers did not have supporting information to indicate that the education outside of U.S. is equivalent to a high school diploma program in the United States. Education documents were not translated into English.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §746.1111)

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: Fire extinguishers present at the operation were not serviced timely. Last inspection was completed September 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Updated feeding instructions for 2 infants were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: City and Fire inspections were not completed within the 12 month time frame. Last completed inspection was in 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: An infant was observed asleep in a bouncer seat with a blanket on top of his body. Infant was not removed from device as soon as possible.      NOTE: Infant was removed from restrictive device and placed in their crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: An individual without a background check was present during inspection completing custodian/cleaning responsibilities.       NOTE: Individual left the operation during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - No Beverages with Added Sugar: The operation had concentrated juice of several flavors that were not 100% juice and had added sugars. It was confirmed that beverage had been given to children enrolled.    NOTE: Juice cans were removed by Director during inspection. Director was unaware of juice cans not being 100% juice.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - No Beverages with Added Sugar, unless allowed by CACFP (26 TAC §746.3301(g))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: A screen time activity was provided during mealtime as observed at the operation. Children were watching a movie while eating breakfast in the Pre-K classroom.      NOTE: TV was turned off and planned activities were resumed by caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: Documentation of Fire drills for the months of April and May 2022 were not available for review.       NOTE: Director documented the completed drills.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside: Emergency Diagrams are missing the designated location inside the child-care center where all caregivers and children take shelter from threatening weather.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside (26 TAC §746.5207(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion: Operational policies were reviewed and the following items are missing:    -Suspension and expulsion policy  -Transportation Policy  -Water Activities Policy  -Field Trips Policy  -Physical and Outdoor Activity Policy  -Sunscreen and Insect REpellant Policy  -Parent participation policy  -Employee vaccine requirement policy  -Statement indicating parents may visit at anytime during operational hours without prior notice
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion (26 TAC §746.501(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: Operation has a structure with a height over 20 inches and a spring rider; structures are surrounded by 2-5 inches of pea gravel. Spring rider is within three feet from a wall.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))
